journeys.label: Type 2 diabetes maintenance with possible GLP-1 prior authorization
Obesity without diabetes, GLP-1 for weight management
Rheumatoid arthritis, methotrexate then TNF inhibitor
Oral hormonal therapy after breast cancer

glp1_type2_diabetes.name: GLP-1 receptor agonists for type 2 diabetes

criteria.description: Documented diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus (ICD-10 E11.x)
Member is 18 years of age or older
HbA1c of 7.0% or higher within the past 90 days
Trial of metformin for at least 90 days, or documented intolerance or contraindication to metformin

any.description: Metformin trial of at least 90 days
Documented intolerance or contraindication to metformin

criteria.description: No personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or MEN 2
Not used in combination with another GLP-1 receptor agonist

glp1_weight_management.name: GLP-1 receptor agonists for chronic weight management

criteria.description: Member is 18 years of age or older
BMI of 30 or higher, or BMI of 27 or higher with at least one weight-related comorbidity (hypertension, dyslipidemia, obstructive sleep apnea, prediabetes)

any.description: BMI 27 or higher with a weight-related comorbidity

criteria.description: Participation in a structured lifestyle program (diet and exercise) for at least 3 months
No personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or MEN 2
Not used in combination with another GLP-1 receptor agonist
Documented diagnosis of moderate to severe rheumatoid arthritis (ICD-10 M05.x or M06.x)
Member is 18 years of age or older
Trial of methotrexate for at least 90 days, or documented intolerance or contraindication to methotrexate

any.description: Methotrexate trial of at least 90 days
Documented intolerance or contraindication to methotrexate

criteria.description: Negative tuberculosis screening documented before starting therapy
Prescribed by, or in consultation with, a rheumatologist
